generations.prompt: Original grounded science-fiction horror environment concept for NULL MERIDIAN, an abandoned orbital research and rescue station. Interior of a believable observation gallery at human eye level, asymmetrical cinematic wide composition. Thick ivory ceramic pressure panels with fine surface crazing, deep graphite structural ribs and beveled machined joints, brushed-metal utility cabinets, exposed cable looms contained in trays, warm practical pools, restrained aged ochre warning markings, small desaturated teal CRT instruments. A massive segmented pressure window on the far wall reveals a pale cream ringed gas giant against truly dark space. Sparse red emergency lights provide contrast, but surfaces remain readable. Signs of long neglect: maintenance cart left open, a removed panel, dust at edges, no gore, no people. Sophisticated AAA game environment concept, physically plausible material hierarchy, fine contact depth, architectural rhythm, 28mm camera. No recognizable franchise design, no logos, no neon cyberpunk, no fog-smothered darkness, no generic cube corridor. This is a concept painting, not a screenshot of a running game.

processing.runtime: Node-only deterministic build; no Python runtime dependency, downloaded model, decoder service, or runtime CDN.
processing.materials: Azure albedo sources are 1024 square. Ceramic 2048 output is explicitly a bilinear upsample with seam crossfade, not native 2K generation. Microheight/roughness/metalness are documented artistic approximations, not recovered physical ground truth.
processing.geometry: Original authored meshes in meters, batched by sector/material. Three.js geometry tools used offline. Threat has continuous pressure-textile lofts, distinct composite shell edges, purpose-sized garment badges and articulated rigid-node glTF clips, not skinned mocap or production skeletal animation.
processing.exterior: Original Azure neutral cloud source remapped to a true distant sphere, with an authored day/night lighting approximation. The v10 bounded repair replaces disconnected opaque rings with one continuous annulus carrying an original512x4 muted radial RGBA density texture, with two broad troughs and feathered edges. Center, original inner/outer radii and orientation are unchanged. Original station spar/antenna geometry. Not a flat picture substituted for3D environment.
processing.visorV10: Dedicated non-emissive tinted material and physically curved visor surface replace the planar polished cap only. Revision2 uses a globally smooth paraboloid with analytical surface normals, removing the first candidate's radial-X facet highlight found in actual unchanged game lighting. Roughness0.42/metalness0.08; shared equipment visor material unchanged. No exposure/flashlight reduction. Rig, clip samples, body bounds and other geometry remain v9-identical.
processing.reflection: Original low-dynamic-range equirectangular reflection field; not HDR and not a photographed probe.
